title: One Step Forward
description: Outdoor wall mural depicts a large teal-painted crouching figure reaching toward a box inscribed "ONE STEP FORWARD THREE STEPS BACK," attributed in script to "Edwin age 6½." Below the mural, a small black-and-white Mr. Snowmann tag figure stands at ground level.
